init.title: E-REDES – cost
init.description:
Prices each imported 15-minute reading for its own interval and stores the result as the statistic 'E-REDES Cost', to select in the Energy Dashboard as 'an entity tracking the total costs'.

• Coopérnico: Coopérnico Único indexed price ((OMIE + ERC) × losses + K + TAR + TSE) from Tiago Felícia's open data (dados.tiagofelicia.pt), with history for the current year.
• Price sensor: a sensor in €/kWh with long-term statistics; only prices recorded since it exists.
